Delete recovery artifacts after Issue finalization (#218)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-47
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - enqueue exact cancellation recovery refs and snapshots only after receipt-backed Issue finalization or explicit Issue cancellation
    - defer cleanup while an Attempt, cancellation, recovery, or Attention consumer remains active
    - delete exact refs with OID compare-and-delete, read back absence, and retain preservation manifests and digests
    - keep recovery cleanup idempotency separate from immediate post-terminal cleanup
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres post_terminal_cleanup --lib` (3 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker cleanup --lib` (22 passed)
    - `cargo check -p codeon-api`
    
    ## Known baseline blockers
    
    - `cargo test -p codeon local_cleanup --lib` is blocked by the pre-existing non-exhaustive `ActivityRecordOutcome::IgnoredLegacyPolicy` match in `execution/agents/grok.rs`.
    - migration acceptance is blocked by the baseline duplicate `0132` migration authority and its stale expected maximum version.
